data_source.primary: OpenF1 public API https://api.openf1.org/v1 (car_data, laps, drivers, sessions, meetings)
data_source.why_switched: The F1 live-timing static host used by FastF1 returned HTTP 401 for every session file and FastF1's mirror 404 (see access.probe); only 2026 Hungarian GP FP2/Race telemetry was in the FastF1 cache. Switched to OpenF1 after the pre-specified proxies and tests were frozen; proxies/thresholds are unchanged.
data_source.join: meeting by (year, event name); session by name; driver by acronym; lap by lap_number; lap cut at OpenF1 date_start for lap_duration; laps with |OpenF1 - FastF1 lap time| > 0.3 s dropped
data_source.rate_limit: <= 2.0 requests/s, exponential backoff on 429/5xx, raw responses cached gzipped

meta.primary_sample: 2025 and 2026, Race + FP2 per event, long-run green laps (practice: race-sim runs)
meta.extension_sample: 2023 and 2024 on the same rules; reported separately, never pooled into the primary
